description.narrative: The main purpose of this project is for VU Colombia to identify a partner that shares the same goals, vision, and ambitions for the partnership. Denmark is a small part of a big, globalized world, and Venstres Ungdom therefore seeks to participate actively in global society. The aim of the partnership is to establish a collaboration that works actively on human rights, more specifically women's rights, and supporting basic rights such as abortion. The chosen destination is Colombia, with the hope of locating a partner in Bogot�. The organizations to be met, Mesa, are an organization focusing on youth and female empowerment, that aims to help women and young people in sensitive situations in society, especially focusing on women's right to health and reproductive rights, especially fighting for women's right to safe abortion. Colombia presents a compelling destination for a partnership due to its progress in peace and stability, alongside ongoing challenges in human rights, particularly regarding gender equality and women's rights. These challenges align with VU Colombia�s goals of actively promoting human rights, with a focus on women�s rights, including reproductive rights such as abortion. The collaboration would allow for knowledge sharing across borders, with mutual respect for contextual differences, fostering a partnership that supports gender equality. We will enter this journey with a respectful, curious mindset and an eagerness to learn. Mesa shares the democratic values of VU, with a focus on promoting equal rights and women's right to health, and we therefore believe that a partnership could yield an impactful project.
